import subprocess, os, textwrap, sys

def run_case(name, content, expect_grid=None, expect_nosol=False, expect_fail=False, use_blank=False):
    path_in = f"/tmp/case_{name}.txt"
    path_out = f"/tmp/out_{name}.txt"
    if content is None:
        # missing file case
        if os.path.exists(path_in): os.remove(path_in)
    else:
        with open(path_in,'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/solve_puzzle.py',path_in,path_out],capture_output=True,text=True)
    out_exists = os.path.exists(path_out)
    out_content = open(path_out).read() if out_exists else '<missing>'
    status=[]
    if expect_fail:
        ok = (r.returncode!=0)
        status.append('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
    elif expect_nosol:
        ok = (r.returncode==0 and out_content.strip()=="NO SOLUTION")
        status.append('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
    elif expect_grid is not None:
        ok = (r.returncode==0 and out_content.strip()==expect_grid.strip())
        status.append('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
    else:
        status.append('INFO')
    print(f"[{','.join(status)}] {name}: rc={r.returncode} out={repr(out_content[:200])} err={repr(r.stderr.strip()[:200])}")
    return r, out_content

# 1. simple solvable 3x3 plus shape? row clues: 1 / 3 / 1 ; col clues: 1/3/1 -> plus shape
run_case("plus", "ROWS: 3\nCOLS: 3\nROW_CLUES:\n1\n3\n1\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n3\n1\n", expect_grid=".#.\n###\n.#.")
# 2. empty row with 0
run_case("empty0", "ROWS: 2\nCOLS: 2\nROW_CLUES:\n0\n2\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n1\n", expect_grid="..\n##")
# 3. full row/col
run_case("full", "ROWS: 2\nCOLS: 2\nROW_CLUES:\n2\n2\nCOL_CLUES:\n2\n2\n", expect_grid="##\n##")
# 4. empty as blank line: 2x2, row0 blank(empty), row1 "2"; col 1/1
run_case("blank", "ROWS: 2\nCOLS: 2\nROW_CLUES:\n\n2\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n1\n", expect_grid="..\n##")
# 5. unsolvable (sample)
run_case("nosol", "ROWS: 1\nCOLS: 1\nROW_CLUES:\n1\nCOL_CLUES:\n0\n", expect_nosol=True)
# 6. missing file
run_case("missing", None, expect_fail=True)
# 7. malformed (non-integer)
run_case("malformed", "ROWS: 2\nCOLS: 2\nROW_CLUES:\nfoo\n2\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n1\n", expect_fail=True)
# 8. malformed (wrong count)
run_case("badcount", "ROWS: 2\nCOLS: 2\nROW_CLUES:\n1\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n1\n", expect_fail=True)
# 9. determinism: run plus twice
r1,_=run_case("plus2", "ROWS: 3\nCOLS: 3\nROW_CLUES:\n1\n3\n1\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n3\n1\n", expect_grid=".#.\n###\n.#.")
# 10. larger 5x5 cross
run_case("cross5", "ROWS: 5\nCOLS: 5\nROW_CLUES:\n1\n1\n5\n1\n1\nCOL_CLUES:\n1\n1\n5\n1\n1\n", expect_grid="..#..\n..#..\n#####\n..#..\n..#..")
# 11. conflicting but valid format 2x2
run_case("conflict", "ROWS: 2\nCOLS: 2\nROW_CLUES:\n2\n2\nCOL_CLUES:\n0\n0\n", expect_nosol=True)
